title: Title Page Block
description: Full-page title with party names and document title. All text fields pass through inline markup.

party1.description: First party name. Inline markup applies: **bold**, *italic*, `code`, "quotes", and the change markers {+added text+} (green) / [-removed text-] (red strikethrough). A newline becomes a space — the field is single-line.

party2.description: Second party name. Inline markup applies: **bold**, *italic*, `code`, "quotes", and the change markers {+added text+} (green) / [-removed text-] (red strikethrough). A newline becomes a space — the field is single-line.

title.description: Document title. Inline markup applies: **bold**, *italic*, `code`, "quotes", and the change markers {+added text+} (green) / [-removed text-] (red strikethrough). A newline becomes a space — the field is single-line.
